sources.title: 26B-Suite/Dark-Goetia-26B-A4B-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 📜 Dark Goetia 26B A4B v2 Atmospheric genre LoRA adapter primarily for English-language roleplay (also works in Russian). Adds a darker, more literary tone to the narrative. Designed exclusively to adjust style and response structure in "Dark Fantasy" RP. The adapter does not contain any plots or characters from the training data.
